title: Tear the corners
hook: A fat triangle looks like it has more turn than a thin one. Does it?

knows: what an angle is, measured in degrees
that a straight line is a half turn
doesNotKnow: that the corners of every triangle add to 180 degrees
why: the parallel line through the top corner

misconception: A triangle's angles depend on its shape: a fatter triangle has more total turn.
objective: The learner can say that the three corners of any flat triangle fit together into a straight line (180 degrees), and that a corner growing forces the others to shrink.

claims.text: The three angles of any triangle in the plane add up to 180 degrees, a straight line.
claims.source: Euclid, Elements I.32 (the three interior angles equal two right angles).

claims.text: The stage's triangles have corners tall 70 + 65 + 45, flat 25 + 30 + 125 and lopsided 40 + 110 + 30 degrees, each summing to 180.
claims.source: The stage builds each triangle from two whole-degree base angles and sets the third to 180 minus their sum (law of sines for the apex), so the caption's sum is exact by construction; recomputed with node.

claims.text: Each bottom corner fits exactly between the line through the top corner parallel to the base and one side, so the three corners fill that line.
claims.source: Alternate angles made by a transversal with two parallel lines are equal (Euclid, Elements I.29); the stage turns each base corner half a turn about the midpoint of its side, which carries it onto that alternate angle at the apex.

claims.text: When one corner of a triangle grows, the others must shrink by the same total.
claims.source: Follows from c1: the sum is fixed at 180 degrees.

claims.text: A straight line is a half turn of 180 degrees: two right angles, not one.
claims.source: Definition of a straight angle; a right angle is 90 degrees (any geometry text). · Fact-check pass 19 2026-10-14: verified as definition: straight angle = 180 deg, right angle = 90 deg (Euclid, Elements I Def. 10 and Prop. I.13: angles on a straight line equal two right angles).

recall.question: A triangle has one corner of 90 degrees and another of 35 degrees. What is the third corner?
options: It depends on how long the sides are
recall.why: The three corners of any flat triangle fill a straight line, 180 degrees, so the third is 180 - 90 - 35 = 55.
